name: feature.creative-video.nodes
description: AI video node pack (ADR 0404) — `generate` (avatar script→MP4 via the HeyGen-class provider), `text-to-video` (frontier text→video, ADR 0404 §P4, behind the creative-video.t2v sub-toggle), and `status`. All ride the Connections broker (async submit→poll→download→media asset; ADR 0106 cost-metered; replay-safe — the asset id is the recorded output, never a regenerate). Over ctx.features['creative-video']; adapterOnly consumer of the heygen + runway providers.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: AI Video: Generate
nodes.description: Generates an avatar video from a script over ctx.features['creative-video'].generateVideo (async: submit → bounded-poll → download → media asset). Inputs: { orgId, script, avatarId, voiceId? }. Output: { success, status: 'completed'|'pending'|'failed', jobId, assetId? } — on completion the output is the MEDIA ASSET ID (replay returns it, never regenerates). Cost-metered (ADR 0106 video); the governed spend rides the adapterOnly heygen provider.

nodes.label: AI Video: Text-to-Video
nodes.description: Generates a video directly from a text prompt with a frontier text-to-video model (Runway/Veo/Sora-class) over ctx.features['creative-video'].textToVideo (async: submit → bounded-poll → download → media asset). Inputs: { orgId, prompt, model?, durationSec? }. Output: { success, status: 'completed'|'pending'|'failed', jobId, assetId? } — the asset id is the recorded output (replay returns it). Gated by the creative-video.t2v sub-toggle (AND the parent); metered at a heavier weight against the ADR 0106 daily video budget; governed spend rides the adapterOnly runway provider.

nodes.label: AI Video: Job Status
nodes.description: Reads a video job's status over ctx.features['creative-video'].getVideoStatus — resolves a `pending` generate into its final asset id once the provider finishes. Inputs: { orgId, jobId }. Output: { success, status, assetId?, error? }.
